images.filename: Bit.fall waterfall on the Olympic Park (7724460014).jpg
images.caption:
‘bit.fall’, an art installation by German artist Julius Popp, is located under the main bridge leading into the Olympic Park between the Aquatics Centre and Water Polo Arena. It consists of five waterfalls, each creating a continuous cascade of words - Russia in this photo - formed of hundreds of water droplets taken from the river 

below. The words are chosen at random from live news feeds.
